requirement.description: The VFS._find method does not properly handle dotfile visibility according to the configured dotfile access settings, causing test failures in test_dots.py. The method should respect the dotsrch configuration when determining visibility of dotfiles.
requirement.contract: The VFS._find method should properly apply dotfile access rules based on the dotsrch setting in the configuration when resolving paths. When dotsrch is enabled, dotfiles should be accessible; when disabled, they should be filtered out.

requirement.description: Configuration parsing fails when processing certain accs entries in test_idp.py, specifically with validation of accs entries in the format 'rwmdgGha: user1, user2, ...'. The validation logic is too strict and doesn't properly handle valid configurations.
requirement.contract: The configuration parser should correctly validate accs entries in the format 'rwmdgGha: user1, user2, ...' and accept valid entries that contain periods in usernames. The validation should properly handle comma-separated lists of users.

requirement.description: The VFS.ls method incorrectly filters dotfiles in certain contexts, particularly when dealing with virtual filesystem nodes. This causes discrepancies in test results for the VFS test suite.
requirement.contract: The VFS.ls method should properly handle dotfile visibility based on the dotsrch configuration when listing directory contents, ensuring that dotfiles are either included or excluded consistently based on user permissions and configuration settings.

requirement.description: There's an inconsistency in how the _read_vol_str method handles special character permissions ('g', 'G'). The mapping for 'g' and 'G' is duplicated and incorrect, which affects how permissions are assigned to users.
requirement.contract: The _read_vol_str method should correctly map 'g' to uget and 'G' to upget permissions respectively, without duplication or incorrect mappings.

requirement.description: The VFS.walk method has incorrect dotfile filtering logic that doesn't properly respect the dots configuration when walking directories, causing test failures in test_dots.py.
requirement.contract: The VFS.walk method should properly apply dotfile access rules when traversing directories based on the dotsrch setting and user permissions.
